law_1i_verbatim: ADEQUACY PRECONDITION. Every comparison of a measured statistic against a threshold in this protocol has a precondition: the reading must be a measurement of which side of the threshold it falls on. It is such a measurement only if the absolute margin between reading and threshold EXCEEDS the replicate spread of that same statistic under the same instrument, measured across the instrument's declared seed ensemble. Margin not exceeding spread yields ADEQUACY_PRECONDITION_UNMET — not a verdict in either direction, never readable as one; no conditional keyed on the comparison applies, because its precondition failed. The response is to increase resolving power and re-measure — never to move the threshold, never to pick the side that suits, never to commit and challenge afterward. Where no replicate spread has ever been measured for a statistic the comparison is ADEQUACY_UNASSESSED until one is. A spread of a DIFFERENT statistic is not a spread; a deterministic computation with no seed ensemble is spread-inapplicable and adequate at any positive margin. Rationale, declared before the retroactive sweep: a committed verdict acquires inertia and everything downstream reasons from it — the cost of staying an unreproducible reading is a delay; the cost of committing one is a load-bearing number nobody can dislodge. Retroactive application is mandatory and symmetric: a PASS found unmet is re-marked exactly as a FAIL would be.

statistic_precision_note: every clearing comparison uses the SAME functional: relative pairwise effect |a-b|/mean(|a|,|b|) on one axis under one instrument. max_seed_only_effect is that SAME functional computed between same-family seed variants — the null distribution of the clearing statistic. Census rho, 1a min-rho, floor statistics and event counts are DIFFERENT functionals and cannot inherit R4 spreads.
